text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morning!
Thank you so much for giving me yesterday off!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to rest too, Trainer?
I went shopping and had meals
with my classmates—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we also talked about
everyone's Trainers.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What I said is a secret!
Now then, let's start training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Narita Top Road
enjoyed a refreshing break.
